title: Home Assistant Integration Icons (icons.json)
description: JSON schema for the icons.json file in a Home Assistant integration. Mirrors the schema hassfest enforces in script/hassfest/icons.py: entity icons by domain and translation_key, service action icons, and icons for the config, options, issue, trigger and condition flows. See: https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/integration-quality-scale/rules/icon-translations

services.description: Service action icon definitions mapped by service action name.

additionalProperties.description: Icon definition for a single service action.

service.description: Icon (mdi:) to represent the service action in UI editors.

sections.description: Optional mapping of collapsible section keys to icons.

entity.description: Entity icons by domain and translation_key. An entity whose device_class already supplies a suitable icon needs no entry here.

issues.description: Icons for the steps and sections of each issue's repair flow.

triggers.description: Trigger icons mapped by trigger name.

conditions.description: Condition icons mapped by condition name.

icon.description: An MDI icon reference in the form mdi:icon-name. Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore allowed.

stateMap.description: Mapping of raw state values to icons. An icon identical to the default is rejected by hassfest.

rangeMap.description: Mapping of numeric thresholds to icons. Keys must be numeric and listed in ascending order.

state_attributes.description: Per-attribute icons, keyed by attribute name.

flowIcons.description: Icons for the steps of a data entry flow, and the sections within them.
